shots.line: You're not still angry about what happened.
shots.scene: Extreme close-up bigFace HERO, jaw tight, half in shadow, cold window rim on one side, slow push

shots.line: You're angry that it didn't happen differently.
shots.scene: Pull back from the face to reveal HERO alone on a chair in the dark apartment, window blinds stripe him, warm doorway far behind

shots.line: I was nineteen the last time I spoke to him.
shots.scene: THE DOORWAY at night: HIM walks out, back to us, into the warm hallway; door stays open. AGE 19 tag on 'nineteen'

shots.line: I've had that conversation four hundred times since.
shots.scene: Top-down: HERO lying awake in bed, streetlight bars sweep across him; ghost speech bubbles pop; counter x1 -> x400 on 'four hundred'

shots.line: In the shower.
shots.scene: Insert: water streams down blue tiles, HERO silhouette behind frosted glass, mouth moving

shots.line: On the bus.
shots.scene: Night bus window: rain on glass, city bokeh sliding past, HERO's head against the glass

shots.line: At three in the morning.
shots.scene: Dark bedroom, phone lights HERO's face as he sits up; bedside clock reads 3:00 AM

shots.line: Every time, I win.
shots.scene: Apartment wide: HERO stands and points, confident, at the empty chair; a translucent ghost of HIM in the chair bows his head

shots.line: Every time, I say the perfect thing.
shots.scene: bigFace HERO smirking, a glowing gold speech bubble blooms beside him on 'perfect'

shots.line: And every time, I wake up,
shots.scene: Grey morning: HERO's face sideways on the pillow, eyes snap open on 'wake'

shots.line: and it still went the way it went.
shots.scene: Grey replay of THE DOORWAY: HIM rewinds back in, then walks out again exactly the same; scan-line glitch

shots.line: That's what people get wrong about forgiveness.
shots.scene: Slow push toward a closed apartment door, thin warm light under it. Nothing else

shots.line: It isn't saying it was okay.
shots.scene: Insert, just hands: HIM's hand offered from the right, HERO's hand stays back and turns away

shots.line: It isn't letting them back in.
shots.scene: Inside the door: HERO's hand slides the chain lock into place; warm hallway light and a shadow at the gap

shots.line: It's putting down the case you've been building.
shots.scene: Insert: a thick CASE FILE folder set down on a table, hands let go, dust puffs up

shots.line: Because you've been a lawyer for years now —
shots.scene: Courtroom establishing (tall stack): empty courtroom, light shafts, HERO alone at the prosecution table shuffling papers

shots.line: collecting evidence for a trial
shots.scene: Evidence wall: pinned photos, papers, red string; HERO pins one more; camera tilts up the wall

shots.line: that is never going to happen.
shots.scene: Insert: the gavel lies on a dusty block, a cobweb strung from it; dust in the light, slow push

shots.line: They moved on.
shots.scene: Bright golden street: HIM walks away down the sidewalk, easy stride, back to us

shots.line: They sleep fine.
shots.scene: Another city, warm lamp: HIM asleep, peaceful, blanket rising and falling

shots.line: You're the only one still sitting in that courtroom.
shots.scene: 3D: empty courtroom, rows of benches, HERO the only figure seated, dust in a light shaft, slow dolly

shots.line: Forgiving the past is not a gift you give them.
shots.scene: Low angle: the empty judge's bench looms; a small wrapped gift sits before it, ribbon slipping loose

shots.line: It's you deciding you've served enough time —
shots.scene: Cell: HERO's hands on the bars, fingers slowly loosening and letting go

shots.line: for something you didn't even do.
shots.scene: Cell wall of tally marks, years of them; camera drifts along, more marks appear

shots.line: You were never the judge.
shots.scene: From behind: HERO small at the bottom, looking up at the huge empty judge's chair

shots.line: You were the one in the cell.
shots.scene: REVEAL freeze: pull back through bars, HERO is inside the dock-cell in the courtroom; dust frozen, cool tint
THE DOORWAY again, same frame as s03: empty, door open, dawn light pours in and fills the room
